verses.1: I will stand on that platform, and wait to see what is said about me, and what I should reply to those who ask questions of me.
verses.2: And Jehovah answered me, and he said, “Write down these words on tablets so that people may read them.”
verses.3: For the time has come; he must hurry and act quickly. He cannot delay any longer. He must wait for him to arrive, for he will surely come. There’s no other way.
verses.4: See, his soul is not pure; yet the righteous will live because of his faithfulness.
verses.5: And even though the sea tells of a proud and arrogant man, who does not listen to anyone. He is like death; he cannot be appeased. All the nations gathered around him, and all the peoples came to him.
verses.6: These all will be placed upon him as a burden. They will curse him and say, “Oh, how miserable he is! He will not be able to live until his death.”
verses.7: Quickly, you will rise up from your positions. Your fears will be dispelled, and you will become free from all worries.
verses.8: For you are the ruler of many nations. You will rule over all the nations of the world, along with all those who live in the land of Kriya and all its inhabitants.
verses.9: He did evil deeds in his house, so that he could be saved from all harm.
verses.10: You have chosen to bring many nations into your house, but your soul is full of sin.
verses.11: For a stone from the wall will cry out, and a branch from the tree will wither.
verses.12: May he build a city in those lands, and may he make it strong with his efforts.
verses.13: Look! From before Jehovah’s armies, they will be destroyed by fire; nations will be destroyed by darkness. They will be swept away by the wind.
verses.14: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Jehovah’s glory, just as waters cover the sea.
verses.15: Oh, how they fill their hearts with your warmth! They are willing to pay a price just to be able to gaze upon their surroundings.
verses.16: May you be blessed with peace and joy. May God bless you as well. May He grant you peace and happiness.
verses.17: For the lion covers us with his roar, and the wolf destroys everything in its path. It also destroys the land and all its inhabitants.
verses.18: What’s the use of a statue, if its creator is also a liar? For surely, whoever creates such a statue will surely also worship idols and gods.
verses.19: Oh, say to the tree of life: “Turn away from me! It is worthless. It contains no gold, no silver, and no soul at all.”
verses.20: And Jehovah will be in His holy house; all the earth will be under His rule.
